design_sources.use: Design input only; no source text copied. Taken ideas: rows walk parents first; a row restarts from its parent's state only when the parent is not row t-1; only rows some later child restarts from are retained; the commit replays the accepted path from the round's input state with retained per-row prework instead of exporting per-node states.
design_sources.declared_storage_note: Upstream K1TR stores only flagged parents but still declares kept[TL][4], i.e. full tree width. No register, occupancy, peak-memory or throughput saving is claimed for upstream or for this candidate.

modifications: Compressed restart slots (local, deliberate): a host plan maps only parents referenced non-consecutively (p >= 0 and p != t - 1) to compact slots 0..K-1; the Metal source declares kept[KSLOTS][N] with KSLOTS = max(1, K), not tree width.
Forests: a -1 parent after row 0 restarts from the retained entry state (upstream K1TR assumes a single root at row 0).

Strict host plan: parents must be a list or tuple of plain int (bool, float, numpy scalars and strings refused, nothing truncated), row 0 is -1, every other parent is -1 or 0 <= p < row, width 1..32. Plans are frozen and re-derived from their parents and digest before any use; forged or replaced plans are refused.
Bounded geometry: B1, Dk = Dv = 128, scalar gates, q/k/v share bf16 or fp32, g/beta/state fp32 only (no per-token state cast), Hv % Hk == 0, 1 <= Hk <= Hv <= 128.

The forward returns readouts plus frozen host snapshots of entry state and per-row prework; it never exports per-node states. Accepted root-to-node paths (prefix or not) are replayed from the entry. CPU all-node states exist only in the diagnostic oracle.
Receipts separate host planning/reference execution from device engagement; nothing on the CPU path can report device engagement.
Metal dispatch entry points refuse unless explicitly opted in and on the default GPU device; CPU tests forbid every Metal construction, dispatch and capability query.

Root pre-review fixes (radio 2866-2868): launches are counted as issued only (lazy graph nodes); device engagement is counted solely by confirm_device_engagement reading a kernel-written uint32 flag back as 1 on the GPU, and only for flags from kernels built by this module's own builder cache (mocked or substituted kernels never count).
verified_plan is a pure re-derivation (_derive_plan) that touches no counters.
Host executors refuse unless mx.default_device() is the CPU, before any tensor capture.

Forward records are replayable only as the exact issued object (weak registry) whose plan digest/parents, geometry, dtype, schema and prework digest still match a process-keyed HMAC binding taken at issue; copies, dataclasses.replace retargeting, in-place forgery and missing bindings are refused.
The Metal forward/replay functions are low-level, unbound experiments: not bound to a forward record, cache revision or commit, and unable to qualify a cache commit.

Root repair-review (radio 2871-2872): pending engagement flags are held in a WeakValueDictionary, so telemetry never owns a launch's graph and a dropped flag leaves the table; the prework digest binds every part's dtype and shape as well as its bytes. Record guards protect against accidental retargeting, not an in-process adversary.
validation: tests/test_qwen38_tree_gdn.py (CPU only, 98 tests): plan refusals, forged-plan refusal, geometry refusals, chain/branch/forest/fan/deep and seeded random trees (44 parity cases: sparse vs all-node oracle readouts and every accepted root-to-node path vs the all-node oracle and the ordinary per-path chain), arbitrary-prefix and non-ancestor path refusal, zero and many retained slots, input immutability, record retargeting/forgery refusal, pure plan verification under threads, GPU-default refusal before capture, lazy/mocked issuance never engaged, weak pending flags released after GC, same-bytes reshape of retained prework refused, no Metal calls at import or in tests

Mutation checks run by the builder: slot carry, slot off-by-one, forest carry, registry removal, binding removal, mock-kernel registration, strong pending-flag table and shape-free prework digest each fail tests

Root independently verified the frozen builder revision: 98 CPU tests passed; seven in-memory source mutations were rejected. Two additional CPU witnesses at the local Qwen3.8 artifact geometry Hk=16, Hv=48, Dk=Dv=128, width 7 matched all readouts and every accepted path in fp32/bf16. These witnesses share the host arithmetic and are not native/model qualification. Root corrected only the host-entry storage docstring, not arithmetic.
